jc.t: Meeting with President Jomo Kenyatta at State House
w: On hearing of the visit the President himself came out to welcome Swamishri.
Swamishri blessed a Parents Convention held in the mandir.

Swamishri attended the 1st Annaual Day celebration of the Pramukh Swami Computer Institute. Swamishri blessed the students, "Practice Satsang sincerely. Character is the main thing. Without character, all this knowledge is of no use."
After lunch Swamishri met the Mahamantri of Bharat Sadhu Samaj, Mahamandaleshwar Pujya Harinarayananandji.
At 7.00 pm Swamishri arrived in Amdavad.

Swamishri performed the murti-pratishtha rituals of Shri Akshar Purushottam Maharaj, Shri Ghanshyam Maharaj, Shri Harikrishna Maharaj, Shri Radha Krishna Dev, Shri Ram Panchayatan, Shri Tirupati Balaji and Padmavatiji, Shri Shiv Panchayatan and Guru Parampara. During the pratishtha assembly Pujya Viveksagar Swami explained the need for mandirs. Finally, Swamishri blessed the assembly, “Just as we have to daily attend to our work at the office or factory, similarly, one needs to go for God's darshan. It makes our daily work easier. There is peace in our family and in ourselves.” More than 2000 devotees and wellwishers attended the pratishtha festival.

In the evening assembly Shri Shri Shri Balagangadharnath – head of Adi Chunchungiri Pith, Swami Shri Shri Shri Shivpuri Mahaswamiji – head of Omkar Ashram, Shri Shri Nityanand Swami – head of Bidadi Dhyan Pith and Mayor of Bangalore Shri P.R. Ramesh were welcomed by Swamishri. The assembly guests briefly addressed the audience.

Swamishri performed the murti-pratishtha rituals of pujan and arti of ten BAPS kutir mandirs for ten villages, namely: Bilpodi (sherimal), Kangvi, Sundhalvan, Khanda-bhavada, Hanmalpal, Navi Madhni, Dharasana, Umarsadi, Potivada and Dhej

At 6.45 pm after Viveksagar Swami’s exposition on the Gita the evening Children’s Day program commence with a traditional dance and dramas. Thereafter the Mayor of Surat Dr Mavani and MP Kashiram Rana addressed the assembly. Finally Swamishri blessed the assembly.

Gunatitanand Swami Diksha Bicentenary Celebration: In the morning Swamishri presided over a grand yagna held on the grounds adjacent to the BAPS mandir in Dabhan. More than 2,635 devotees participated in the ritual yagna around 279 yagna kunds and with 175 Brahmin pundits chanting Vedic mantras.In the evening, the celebration assembly commenced at 3.45 p.m. It was relayed live in India and abroad. The assembly theme was based on Gunatitanand Swami’s universal glory. The assembly programme included speeches by senior sadhus, mantras sung by children and a drama by youths. The celebration climaxed with Swamishri’s blessings. For a detailed report see Swaminarayan Bliss, February 2010, pp. 23-25.
Guru’s guidance

26 December 2009, Mahelav An aspirant, practicing meditation daily, asked Swamishri, “I meditate daily. In it all my thoughts cease altogether. But then I experience blankness.” Swamishri guided, “Do mala of Bhagwan Swaminarayan. You will see his murti.” The aspirant asked, “Is my meditation alright?”Swamishri assured him, “Yes. Do mala of Swaminarayan and you will see Maharaj.”
Teaching today's lesson in the class on Brahmavidya, Pramukh Swami Maharaj said:
"Keep talking about satsang to whoever comes into contact with us."
Teaching the lesson of today's Brahmavidya class, Swamishri said:
"Keep talking about satsang to whoever comes into contact with us."

For the last sixteen days, Mahant Swami Maharaj had been writing on a digital slate every day, teaching priceless lessons of Brahmavidya (spiritual knowledge). Everyone wished to capture this memory on film. So today before breakfast, to take a picture of Swamishri writing on the digital slate, Swamishri was given the blank slate and pencil to hold. But how could Swamishri ever be comfortable with something pretend and false?! Enthusiasm welled up in his heart and he wrote, "Divine, divine, everything is divine."
With this "bonus" lesson of Brahmavidya, the departing year was blessed today.

After the evening meal, Brahmvatsaldas Swami began to show Mahant Swami Maharaj a video comparing the smallest satellite of our solar system, the earth's moon, with the largest possible planet, and then our galaxy, countless galaxies in that perspective, the universe they make up, along with the scientific measurements of all these, and after that countless universes. For lack of time, the video was shown skipping ahead in places... Then, touching a hair on Swamishri's body, he said, "Swami! All this in one pore of yours...!!"

Feeling from the quickly shown video that "this is the talk of only one universe," Swamishri said joyfully, "In one pore of Aksharbrahman there are countless universes!!" Then he said, "Bhagwan has kept only one channel open, the channel of ekantik dharma. If one gets into all the other channels, miracles, the eight siddhis and the nine treasures, one gets lost in them. Moksha does not come into one's hands!" The manifest form of Bhagwan revealed Bhagwan's compassion.

ds.t: Infinite universes in a single hair
w: After the evening meal, Brahmavatsaldas Swami began showing Mahant Swami Maharaj a video comparing the smallest satellite of our solar system, the earth's moon, with the largest possible planet, and after that our galaxy, the infinite galaxies in its perspective, our universe formed from them, along with the scientific measurements of all these, and then the infinite universes. For lack of time, the video was shown skipping ahead in parts... Then, touching a hair of Swamishri's body, he said, "Swami! All this in a single hair of yours...!!"

Since the quickly shown video seemed to be about only one universe, Swamishri said joyfully, "In a single hair of Aksharbrahman there are infinite universes!!" Then he said, "God has kept only one channel open, that of ekantik dharma. If one enters all the other channels, miracles and wonders, the eight siddhis and nine treasures, one gets lost in them. Moksha will not come into one's hands!" The manifest form of God revealed the compassion of God.
